mechanism: Raloxifene enhances intestinal calcium absorption and bone mineralization, and cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) is essential for calcium absorption; concurrent use may increase serum calcium levels and requires monitoring in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor serum calcium levels, particularly in patients with hypercalcemia risk or on high-dose vitamin D supplementation; adjust vitamin D dosing based on serum calcium and 25-OH vitamin D levels.
